scope: Merge the parent SIP audio branch into the interruption lifecycle branch without losing either behavior
acceptance_criteria: Parent changes are included through a merge without rewriting branch history
Preserve parent SIP configuration, media ownership, native resampling, and end-of-speech fixes
Preserve protobuf controls, message ID callback completion, pause/continue/flush behavior, and constructor options
Resolve test conflicts using the current channel and playback contracts
Do not include or overwrite local changes from the testing or Orca worktrees
Move the verified branch to the requested testing checkout
parent_import: All automatically merged tracked changes from the pinned parent commit; allowed_paths lists manual integration edits only

ownership.coordinator: Merge resolution, compatibility testing, evidence, and testing checkout
ownership.independent_reviewer: Read-only comparison of the merged SIP behavior with both parents

risks: Textually clean SIP merges may reintroduce old playback or resampler assumptions
New parent configuration and end-of-speech behavior must remain compatible with lifecycle callbacks
Existing dirty files overlap parent changes, so the merge uses an isolated worktree
Native tests require local audio libraries and may have environment-specific prerequisites

verification_results.parent_parity: End-of-speech, internal options, UI providers, and SIP runtime production retain the incoming parent bytes
verification_results.feature_parity: Message lifecycle, dispatcher handlers, requestor construction, base streamer, and shared telephony playback production retain the previous feature bytes
verification_results.test_corrections: Migrated the new parent STT-order test to WithContextID and injected the existing test streamer and sender. Earlier attempts exposed the removed constructor and missing notification transport. Ordering assertions are unchanged.
verification_results.finalizer_retry: The first finalizer passed all backend checks and all 24 provider UI suites (428 tests), but the UI process stayed in watch mode and timed out. Rerun with CI=true.

independent_review.summary: Compared SIP production to both parents and verified all three manual test resolutions. Parent runtime ownership and config changes coexist with response IDs, playback controls, discarded-output suppression, and native resampler lifetime.

limitations: No live provider or carrier call was performed
The merge retains the previously authorized go-security-scan exception for the CGO-disabled native dependency check; other commit hooks remain enabled
rollback: Revert this merge against its first parent; retain separately owned local changes
